data.name: the Kingdom Fallen
data.detailed_description:
The Fallen Kingdom is a fantasy tactical strategy game featuring brutal small-scale combat, deep unit progression, and diverse heroes and magic. Use simple controls to deploy troops, hold key positions, and wear down undead forces with powerful ranged firepower. Lead an expedition to defeat the evil undead tyrant—carve your way through ravaged lands with tactics and magic.

Command heroes and units in coordinated combat to withstand wave after wave of undead enemies. Every decision matters—do you unleash a skill to clear a crowd of enemies, or save it for the stronger waves ahead? Do you send shield-bearers to the front line, or keep archers in the back for sustained damage? Every map is different, and you must constantly adjust your tactics to face new challenges.

Hunt the Undead Tyrant: You will lead an expeditionary force deep into the cursed lands ravaged by the undead, marching against the evil undead tyrant. Along the way, you will face different enemy types and terrains—each battle consumes your troops and resources. Whether you can ultimately break into the tyrant's throne room depends on every choice you make along the journey.

Brutal Combat: The battles in The Fallen Kingdom are brutal. Fallen soldiers are gone forever—no matter how long you have trained them, one wrong decision can wipe them out. Attrition is a constant threat throughout the campaign. You must constantly weigh progress against losses. There is no second chance—every battle depletes your expeditionary force.

Heroes & Magic: Each hero possesses unique skills and spells that can turn the tide at a critical moment. If a hero falls in battle, they will return in the next encounter—they do not permanently die. But losing their support in a fight can still cost you dearly in that battle.

Grid-Based Movement: The battlefield is divided into a grid of positions. Simply click and drag to deploy your troops anywhere on the field. Melee units hold the front line, while ranged units provide fire from the back. The movement system is intuitive and straightforward, allowing you to focus on tactical decisions rather than complex controls.

Troop Progression: Your army is not static. Through combat, you earn gold and population resources, which you can use to expand your forces, replenish losses, and upgrade elite units into stronger variants. But even a well-upgraded force can suffer heavy losses from a single misstep. Growth and risk always go hand in hand.

data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU, 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible GPU, 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
